title: Chemical Analysis: Purity, Chromatography and Gas Tests

flashcard_questions.q: A substance that contains only one type of element or one type of compound.
A mixture that has been carefully designed to have specific properties by mixing components in precise quantities.
A technique used to separate and identify the substances in a mixture based on how soluble they are in a particular solvent.

flashcard_questions.a: The phase in chromatography that moves — the solvent that carries dissolved substances through the stationary phase.
The phase in chromatography that does not move — the absorbent paper through which the mobile phase travels.
